items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29
items.q: I got one for you too, Ted... By the way, Ted, give me that material other than the newspaper over there.

ctx.x: October the 8th, 1955. Yeah, I like that. That's my material. I got one for you too, Ted. This was the, you were on the Strong Stamp. Oh, okay. Just keep that, we'll get into that later. We'll get to the stamp.
Yeah. Okay, so you all finally got married and?
